window_selection: Full span from earliest to latest consumed pilot week; fixed before new results
funding_interval_assumption: Use point-in-time fundingIntervalHours when recorded; otherwise assume last observed regular settlement gap persists; fallback 8h only if insufficient prior settlements. Never backfill current fundingInfo.
conditional_trailing_test: Only if at least half of losing D trades have confirmed MFE >= 1R; keep trailing distance unchanged
combination_policy: No combined candidate unless one individual mechanism improves both continuous return and mean net R in development; any selected combination remains development-only
stocks: Excluded from main account; reuse pilot stock signals for separate RTH/overnight volatility and cost reachability diagnosis
